## Problem

Describe the user or maintainer problem this change addresses.

## Approach

Explain the smallest relevant implementation and any rejected alternative that affects review.

## Verification

List the exact commands or manual checks run and their results.

## Risk

Describe compatibility, security, migration, or operational risk. Write `None identified` when no material risk remains.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation reflects changed public behavior.
- [ ] No secret, credential, private key, recovery material, or private runtime data is included.
